code:
$ sudo apt update
Fetched 126 kB in 1s

$ sudo apt install nginx
0 upgraded, 3 newly installed, 0 to remove

$ sudo apt remove nginx
$ sudo apt purge nginx
caption: update refreshes metadata only; remove keeps configs, purge deletes them too

code:
$ sudo dnf install nginx
Installing:
 nginx   x86_64   1:1.24.0-1.el9   appstream   570 k

$ sudo dnf update
$ sudo dnf remove nginx
caption: dnf refreshes stale metadata automatically — no separate update step needed first

code:
$ apt list --installed | grep nginx
nginx/noble,now 1.24.0-2ubuntu7 all [installed]

$ dnf list installed | grep nginx
nginx.x86_64   1:1.24.0-1.el9   @appstream
caption: Both tools confirm the exact installed version and which repo it came from

subtitle: Where that newly installed software actually lives on disk.
